name: adw
description: Spec-driven agentic development workflow for Python backends. Ships a 30-skill house-style catalog covering the four layers, their tests, and the derivation between an identifier and a file path; the four roles of the change cycle as subagents (test-author, test-review, implementer, evaluator); three cycle commands (spec, build, accept) plus commit; and the Markdown templates those commands fill (living spec, delta spec, criteria checklist, verdict) with a Makefile carrying the definition of green.
